title: Rationality of the canonical unramified Arthur filtration
exact_target: Let X/Fq be a smooth projective geometrically connected curve and G/Fq split connected semisimple. Assume that the Lie algebra admits an invariant nondegenerate symmetric form nondegenerate on every Levi center, Chevalley restriction is an isomorphism for every Levi, semisimple Lie-element scheme centralizers are Levi subgroups, and every nilpotent Lie element over every extension belongs to the Lie algebra of the unipotent radical of an extension-defined parabolic. Let $A_E$ be finitely supported E-valued functions on the finite-field G-bundle isomorphism classes, $E=Qbar_\ell $. For any closed invariant subset Y of the dual Lie-algebra nilpotent cone, let $F_Y$ $A_E$ be the image of categorical Frobenius trace from the corresponding derived-Satake nilpotent-support subcategory. Must E $tensor_Q$ $(A_Q$ intersect $F_Y$ $A_E)$ map isomorphically to $F_Y$ $A_E$ for every ell different from p, yielding a common rational filtration independent of ell?
